build_contract.mod_repeatability: Built after the source commit so the DLL and portable PDB embed baseline_commit. The exact DLL is carried in the bundle and promoted by SHA-256.
build_contract.gateway_reproducibility: The image payload is the reproducibility unit. Lumberjacks/.dockerignore excludes .git, and the authoritative image build compiles and tests the solution before publish.
build_contract.sibling_reproducibility: Eventlog, progression, and operatorapi use the same tested source stage and are promoted by image digest.

gateway.identity_check: Test-GatewayImageRelease.ps1 read /app/Game.Gateway.dll from the built image and confirmed it admits m11-transport-20260722-r1.

runtime_config.transport_boundary: Lumberjacks owns authenticated HTTP/JSON ZDO delivery and acknowledgement. Native Valheim still owns peer transport, movement, simulation, non-ZDO RPCs, relevance, and receive/application semantics.

deployment.method: Validated release bundle promoted by exact image IDs and mod SHA-256.

limitations: This is a transport-boundary visibility release, not a full Lumberjacks netcode cutover.
Lumberjacks WebSocket and UDP lanes are not used by the live Valheim adapter in this release.
The transport fault switches are process-local alpha diagnostics and reset on restart.
World verification remains required after P7 and both Windows clients carry the same mod artifact.
